_comment: Recall canaries for scripts/recall_canary.py. Each entry calls ONE tool of the target MCP server against the LIVE upstream and asserts a minimum record count. Unlike live_probe.manifest.json — which hits raw upstream URLs — this measures the whole chain, including how the server builds its request. That is where recall bugs live (see termdat-mcp#11). Copy into the target repo and replace the examples with that server's tools. Choose floors at roughly HALF the observed count: the canary must catch a collapse, not track corpus churn. Read-only tools only.

canaries.name: search_common_term
canaries._why: A term with many hits. Catches scope/limit defaults — the failure that keeps the response shape intact and is therefore invisible to live_probe.

canaries.name: search_rare_term
canaries._why: A term with few but non-zero hits. Catches field-coverage narrowing, where a broad query still looks healthy.

canaries.name: list_vocabulary
canaries._why: A bounded list endpoint with a known size. The cheapest canary: if this shrinks, something upstream changed wholesale.
